notes.title: Interlude Patch: Flip The Script
notes.notes: [p]Welcome back, Scribes! It's time for a flippin' new spell![/p][p]This update includes [b]Unfold[/b]: a new [b]Movement Spell[/b], [b]New Maps[/b], A Tutorial Kit adjustment, and some light fixes![/p][p]We also shout out the new Community Mod Library - hardworking Scribes making their mark on the game! Check out the highlights below and keep an eye on the [b]Roadmap[/b] in [i]Vellum's[/i] main menu as we go. [/p][p][/p][h1]New Movement Spell - Unfold[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a5a37375b641d7abe825a5f3e2a90ad54426af74.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Mental gymnastics? Watch this![/i][/p][p]Keep an eye on your foes as you soar backwards through the air with [b]Unfold[/b]![/p][p]This acrobatic Movement Spell flings you out of danger, granting a brief moment of invulnerability, and offers many pages to build more style into your aerial feats![/p][p]Drop deadly mines, craft a winning floor routine, and perform some high-damage trick shots to style on your foes! [/p][p][/p][h1]New Maps[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3029d285277d6cfb4fb2552f5902ee2459457104.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Roots and shoots and roads...[/i][/p][p]Venture to fresh combat arenas: [i]Sequoia[/i] and [i]Outlook[/i]! Fight beneath the tall trees, making use of long-range cover for a forest fight to be remembered.[/p][p]In [i]Outlook[/i], weave between pillars of an ancient structure - where do these old roads lead? Battle the Torn in a time-worn relic of elsewhere![/p][p] [/p][h1]Spend Early, Spend Often - Tutorial Spell Changes[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/19614c658a259af5c79f18998e931b200bc80ba4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Note: This will unlock Callback for all Scribes, while re-locking Swoop![/i][/p][p]We're making some initial changes to the new player experience with adjustments to the Tutorial Chapter! [/p][p]The order of some elements has changed to give Scribes more time to understand the Signature Ink choice they make. Additionally, we're making Callback the new default Spender Spell! [/p][p]This gives new Scribes a more versatile starting spell set to take into their first [i]Of Scribes and Torn[/i] run - Callback's area damage capabilities are a smoother compliment to Jot! [/p][p] [/p][h1]Community - Mods and More![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca043850a17e45e86434c10453b0c58a160ffbee.jpg"][/img][i]Just a bit of tINKering...[/i][/p][p]There has been some awesome community work on Mods for Vellum! Pet the Inkling, pack more decoration into your Reading Nook, and more creative additions await! [/p][p]You can find these mods in the Discord Community Mods Library - a special thanks to the authors for your excitement and sharing your work![/p][p] [/p][h1]Epilogue[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/9b6c070b5d585ffb1e675a5be2accc603edff872.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The quiet calm of a book club![/i][/p][p]Keep an eye out for [i]Vellum[/i] in the Yogscast Small Teams fest currently on Steam! In other news, we're gearing up for the next Major Chapter - more info to come, with plenty to read.[/p][p]Thank you to our testers, everyone in the discord, our newest mod-makers, and Scribes of all Ink Levels! [/p][p]- [i]The Vellum Team[/i][/p][p] [/p][h1]Interlude Patch: Flip The Script - Full Patch Notes [/h1][h2]Movement Spell: Unfold[/h2][p]- [b]Unfold[/b]: Acrobatically flip backwards, becoming Impervious for 0.3s.[/p][p]- New Pages of Power are available for [b]Unfold[/b][/p][p]- A new race and tower jump sequence can be found in the Illuminated Library[/p][h2]New Combat Arenas[/h2][p]- [i]Sequoia[/i] and [i]Outlook[/i] are now available in Tomes![/p][h2]General[/h2][p]- Re-ordered the hierarchy of Signature Status effects on enemy health bars (Outline > Blot > Leech)[/p][p]- Status and Augment effect calculation orders have been re-prioritized (this will result in slightly more damage intake through overlapping damage-reduction effects and an increase in specific damage-amp combinations)[/p][p]- Re-ordered some Tutorial Chapter elements[/p][p]- Tutorial Chapter now has Scribes start with Callback instead of Swoop (Note: this will unlock Callback for all Scribes and lock Swoop)[/p][p]- Adjusted default Camera sensitivity settings and ratios for vertical vs horizontal[/p][p]- Fixed an error in Credits screen[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: A Forgotten Grotto[/b] correctly offers a tradeoff page by default[/p][p]- Added a notification for Vignette rewards when there are no more pages to grant[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with [b]Page of Power: Father of Quill[/b][/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Spotless Floor[/b] is available again, with a new design[i] - [/i]now adds +5 Base Damage to all instances of damage[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Overgrowth[/b] - Now increases Base Damage dealt based on amount of mana spent. (Note: will scale better in late game.)[/p][p]- [b]New Page of Power: The Main Drain[/b] - 25% of damage you deal is also done to your Target if they are tethered.[/p][p]- [b]New Page of Power: Draining Force II[/b] - Draining Force always deals damage equal to  100% of your current health  to tethered foes.[/p][p]- [b]New Page of Power: Ode to the West Wind[/b] - Foil slashes send out Wind Blades that deal 20 Damage and generate a small amount of mana.[/p][p]- [b]Spell:[/b] [b]Draw[/b] - Base Damage reduced from 15 to 12.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Draw[/b] - Cooldown increased from 0.85s to 0.9s.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Foil[/b] - First Slash Damage increased from 15 to 20.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Foil[/b] - Final Slash Damage increased from 25 to 35.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Foil[/b] - Mana Generation increased by 25%.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Jot[/b] - Cooldown decreased from 0.5s to 0.45s.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Manifest[/b] - Base Damage increased from 10 to 12.[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: Thesis, a Ship Rewritten[/b] has received minor adjustments[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: "Spoilers"
notes.notes: [p]Welcome back, Scribes! With [i]1.1: Beyond[/i] now [i]behind[/i] us, we look to new waters - beginning with a fresh new spell! [/p][p][/p][p]--[b] Interlude Patch: "Spoilers"[/b] ahead... --[/p][p][/p][p]This update includes [b]Spoil[/b]: a new [b]Spender Spell[/b], [b]Visual Intensity Settings[/b], [b]Raid-Specific Spell Tuning[/b], and several bug fixes, minor adjustments! Keep an eye out for some snazzy new Nook Items, too![/p][p]Check out the highlights below and, as always, you can track our journey from the [b]Roadmap[/b] in [i]Vellum's[/i] main menu. We also discuss our continuing [i]Vellum[/i] plans at the end of this post! [/p][p][/p][h1]New Spender Spell - Spoil[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/16ffa559c7abe9523acca579c82564a250d5801f.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]How 'bout them apples?[/i][/p][p]Brand new to the spellbook, Scribes get to live a fresh, ripe, totally-not-rotten fairytale fantasy with [b]Spoil[/b]! [/p][p]"Offer" your foes a scrumptious bite of a [b][i]Spoiled Apple[/i][/b] and watch as they share their positive reviews with nearby pals! These Apples are tasty, healthy, and only get better with a hefty helping of Pages of Power![/p][p]Aim true while flinging bushel after bushel of this [b]sticky, explosive 1-Cost Spender[/b]... and find out just how hungry the Torn [i]really[/i] are.[/p][p][/p][h1]Visual Intensity Settings[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Details and details and details![/i][/p][p]We're introducing [b]Visual Intensity Settings[/b] based on your feedback! These new options allow you to further customize your experience for [i]increased performance and legibility[/i] both solo and in multiplayer. [/p][p]In pursuit of these changes, our VFX system has had performance improvements across the board (even without using these new settings!). [/p][p]Player spells and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.[/p][p]Enemy abilities and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.[/p][p]There are a lot of visuals in [i]Vellum[/i] - please let us know how your experience with these new settings goes![/p][p][/p][h1]Raid-Specific Spell Tuning and Balance[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a2b6a6dfee75b65e0fbd68d4c62b08e004ee6285.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The flexible spellcraft of Scribes is a complex curriculum. Time to teach the Torn Lords a lesson or two.[/i][/p][p]With the rise of the Torn Lords, we've found (with the help of plenty of feedback!) the disparity between spell damage across the different loadout options in Raids is larger than we'd like! [/p][p]The lower number of pages available in Raids combined with the Boss/Single-Target heavy encounter profiles, has resulted in some spells falling behind in power/excitement. With [b]Interlude Patch: Spoilers[/b], we're pumping up the damage output of several spells when [b]damaging Raid Bosses only[/b]. [/p][p][b]Foil[/b], [b]Punctuate[/b], [b]Enkindle[/b], [b]Quip[/b], [b]Blossom[/b], [b]Wordsmith[/b], and [b]Passage[/b] will now deal [b]20 - 66% increased damage to Raid Bosses[/b] (details in the patch notes below). Let us know how these feel![/p][p][/p][h1]Epilogue[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/cea9b5b888446e2f286fae829d201515c518cc84.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Finding a cozy nook in the Illuminated Library to keep reading![/i][/p][p]With [b]The Grey Area[/b], [b]The Forgery[/b], and [b]Yonder[/b] now complete along with the [b]Early Access[/b] journey - we're going to be adjusting our cadence of content! We're incredibly proud of the speed, quality, and quantity of [i]Vellum's[/i] [b]Major Chapters[/b] and [b]Interlude Patches[/b] thus far... especially when we're operating as such a small team (if you're active in the [url="https://discord.gg/vellum"]Discord[/url] - you've likely heard from all of us directly by this point!)[/p][p]Since EA launch, we [i]typically[/i] added new content about [b]every two weeks[/b], alternating between [b]Interludes[/b] and [b]Major Chapters[/b]. Of course, some updates had adjusted timings for major life events and bigger-scope items (especially as the Library Update, Raids, and 1.0 approached). [/p][p]As a small team, we'll remain incredibly flexible (today's patch includes feedback from [i]this morning - [/i]we love this!), but we'll be targeting a few more weeks between updates and more [b]Interludes[/b] between [b]Major Chapters[/b]. This new pace lets us stay reactive to feedback, continue to chase cool ideas, and gives us more time to plan what comes next![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing [i]Vellum [/i]and joining us as the literary journey continues to unfold! Go read a book![/p][p]- [i]The Vellum Team[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Interlude Patch: "Spoilers" - Full Patch Notes [/h1][h2]Features[/h2][h3]Spender Spell: Spoil[/h3][p]- Cost: 1 Mana[/p][p]- Sling a [b]Spoiled Apple[/b] that [b]sticks[/b] to foes and [b]bursts[/b] after a short delay.[/p][p]- New [b]Spoil[/b] Pages of Power are now available![/p][h3]Visual Intensity Settings[/h3][p]- Player spells and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting[/p][p]- Enemy abilities and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting[/p][p]- VFX performance improved notes.title: Interlude Patch: In Circulation
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Scribes! It's been almost two weeks since 1.0 dropped and we've been blown away by the enthusiasm and support for [i]Vellum[/i]. Thank you!

Today - we're channeling our [i]own[/i] 1.0 excitement into [b]Interlude Patch: In Circulation[/b]!

This update includes [b]Circulate[/b]: a new [b][i]Movement Spell[/i][/b], [b]Performance and QOL Upgrades[/b], [b]Book Club Reward Updates[/b], [b]Vignette Secrets[/b], an [b]Ascendant Rewards Adjustment[/b], [b]Raid Tuning[/b], [b]Photosensitivity Mode[/b] and many bug fixes.

Check out the highlights of this patch below and watch for our next update: [b]1.1 - Beyond[/b]! As always, you can track our journey from the [b]Roadmap[/b] in [i]Vellum's[/i] main menu [i](quite the saga!)[/i]. 

[h1]New Movement Spell - Circulate[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca28858adf34289cec867609af7f6cc8fbb060c7.gif[/img]
[i]Go for a leisurely scroll...[/i]

Build momentum with mounting anticipation and a trusty Scroll - then zoom off [b]into and through[/b] your foes with the first Movement Spell to have [i]baseline damage[/i]!

What wild combos will you skillfully scrawl into existence? Use the new Pages of Power and clever strategy to show the Torn what 'doom-scrolling' really looks like!

[h1]Vignette Secrets?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8bf32d31898ec7b07274155cecb1f849ee63763f.jpg[/img]
Intrepid adventurers may have noticed some extra secrets and rewards in the various Vignettes found within the Tomes. Sometimes these hidden rewards give new Pages of Power, Temp Mana, or other useful statuses. 

I dare not speak further of such secrets - only to say that [i]previously secret-lacking[/i] [b]Vignettes[/b] are now up to date with something [i]more[/i] to discover. Happy hunting!

[h1]Performance and Quality of Life[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg[/img]
Performance and quality of life have been top of mind for us since the 1.0 launch! With today's Interlude Patch, we're taking a more ink-laden pen to performance! Many of the wild interactions between mechanics in [i]Vellum[/i] come down to core building blocks: [b]Projectiles[/b], [b]Areas of Effect[/b], [b]Statuses[/b], and [b]Augments[/b]. Improvements in this patch aim to smooth out each of these pillars' performance - both in solo and multiplayer games!

We've also made a number of networking changes and upgrades aimed at improving the stability and synchronization of your team-up scribbling adventures!

Elsewhere, in the realm of [b]Quality of Life[/b] - we're directly addressing feedback in a few key areas: we're adding [b]new toggles[/b] for photosensitivity and visual effect intensity, we've clarified [b]language and tutorials[/b] in the beginning of the game and throughout the Binding/Attunement/Ascendant processes, and smoothing out other experience-impacting bugs!

Please continue to share your feedback with us as you interact with these systems!

[h1]Reward Upgrades - Book Club & Ascendant Progress[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/363701efba78a54b73b758b7f3d8e2c43f646850.jpg[/img]
[b]The Book Club[/b] is now more rewarding! From now on, you'll be able to gain a first-time [b]500 Quillmark + Gilding[/b] bonus from playing new Book Club challenges - the perfect way to spice up your journey as a Scribe. Because Book Club challenges are ink-level-agnostic, tackling the Book Club right after Ascending may be a great way to kickstart your level-ups! On that topic...

Ascending is now more clear, [i]no longer restricts[/i] Tome access, and will now allow multiple Bindings to drop at once when Over-binding Tomes! As a bonus - Ascendant Scribes also start with [b]500 Quillmarks[/b] to more flexibly reignite their journey!

Ascending in [i]Vellum[/i] is designed to be an optional way to continue playing the game - we want it to be rewarding and fun, but not feel like a mandatory part of your journey. We'll continue to keep an eye on this system - let us know what you think!

[h1]Raid Tuning[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0b0224fc2ac769a90ecd012f54de11a60084051b.jpg[/img]
We're adjusting and improving many aspects of the Torn Raids - from multiplayer scaling and boss ability frequency to visual telegraphs and Codex hints. Full details are in the patch notes below, but [b]Araxiom[/b], [b]The Taking Tree[/b], [b]Styxen[/b], and [b]both Torn Lords[/b] have all received adjustments.

[b]Quillmark[/b] and [b]Gilding[/b] rewards have also been increased to help celebrate your victories!

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ed9da06cc93332211e5af73045db22f8cc7fc052.jpg[/img]
[i]Eyes on the Horizon...[/i]
[b]1.1 - Beyond[/b] is coming soon and the Tangent Lord's curiosity knows no bounds!

In the meantime, come join us in the official [url=discord.gg/vellum]Discord[/url] to share your feedback and show off your achievements, strategies, and your Reading Nooks designs [i](in a new dedicated channel)[/i]!

If you've been enjoying your time in Vellum, please consider leaving a review on Steam [i](it's a huge help, we read them all, and we always love to hear about your experiences)![/i]

Thank you for playing [i]Vellum[/i] - write on!

- [i]The Vellum Team[/i]

[h1]Interlude Patch: In Circulation - Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[h3]Movement Spell: Circulate[/h3]
- New Spell: Circulate
- Hold & Release: Charge up a Scroll and charge forward when released, damaging foes (Speed and Damage increase with hold time)!
- Tap: Charge a short distance in your movement direction.
- Circulate Pages of Power
- Illuminated Library Race Course
- Illuminated Library Tower Platforming Puzzle

- Photosensitivity Mode
- Arachnophobia updated for Raids

notes.title: Interlude Patch: In The Edit
notes.notes:
Welcome, Scribes!

We hope you've been enjoying all the cozy additions to the new Illuminated Library! Today, we're publishing [b]Interlude Patch: In The Edit[/b]! With the sheer amount of new goodies in our previous Major Chapter - today's patch was the perfect opportunity to take a hard look at every nook and cranny of Vellum, dip into the magic ink, and come up with a myriad of improvements.

This update takes a massive step in the Performance, Balance, Reworks, Polish, and [b]so many[/b] aspects of Vellum!

[h1]Performance, Art[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/97f8c99844526e1057e108161b5d07de42c5a5c6.jpg[/img]
[i]We're addressing one of the Torn's greatest weapons against the Scribes - Framerate.[/i]

We've made [b]absolutely massive[/b] strides in the performance of the game. Playing through a Tome, picking upgrades, waiting for the enemy to begin a battle, casting spells - there are thousands upon thousands of connections between the host of systems in Vellum.

Reducing the performance cost in[i] any single item[/i] could have huge gains. 

We've reduced the cost of: [b]Projectiles, Area Effects, Scribe Passive Stats, Torn Passive Stats, Status Effects, Pages of Power, Signature Ink core mechanics, User Interface items, Screen Effects, Fog, Lighting, every action Scribes and Torn take[/b] - oh and the small item of [b][i]networking all these things[/i][/b].

Multiplayer Games, High Appendix Runs, Steam Decks, PCs of varying power - no matter how you enjoy the magic ink, [i]Vellum [/i]just became that much smoother to play!

[h1]Balancing Spells and Ink[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7af1cccf7016113be533f5e4ddb360e25da13d9c.jpg[/img]
[i]Spells and Ink... dripping with potential![/i]

We're buffing many spells in many ways based on feedback and the continually awesome community discussions! This also comes with some strategic redistribution of power of some spells ([i]Eclipse[/i]) and a handful of minor (but needed) nerfs ([i]Ghostwrite, Vault[/i]). You can read the huge amount of changes in the patch notes a the end of this blog post.

Affected Spells - [b]Punctuate, Quip, Draw, Swoop, Passage, Blossom, Eclipse, Foreshadow, Flutterstep, Ghostwrite, Vault[/b]

Our goal with these changes is to make these spells all more competitive, while opening up their viability when combined with different signature inks (e.g. Draw)! 

On the Signature Ink front, MANY inscriptions have been rebalanced and [b]Green Ink[/b] has been the recipient of several quality of life changes (like a hud indicator) and significant buffs.

[h1]Remastering Tomes and Pacing[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/463096fae2a2a31aa889c31bc64220f542cb9899.jpg[/img]
[i]The Scribes explore magical strengths, collecting powerful Pages - and the Torn rise to meet them...[/i]

Tomes are the battleground of our colorful conflict with the Torn! Bigger and more compelling threats invite stronger choices and more dynamic strategies.

We've refactored the way encounters happen throughout the Tomes - strangely, it's a lot of work that hopefully fades into the background! You'll see a larger variety of foes as you play and the danger ramps up - setting you and the Torn up for more dramatic, compelling, and fluctuating battles!

For new players - we're also opening up the choice to jump into Appendices from the very start! 

[h1]The Clarity of Bindings and Bosses[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ac56f3d552e8666d04878065eee437411df429b0.jpg[/img]
[i]Deeper evils fester and brood![/i]

Bindings have been rebalanced - we're upping the point values to give you more customization AND clarity in the ever-evolving battle with the Torn. Many Bindings now contribute much more to the Attunement goal while playing - though be warned, the Torn still grow stronger!

At the end of these newly re-organized Tomes, held together with reevaluated Bindings - who better to test your rebalanced Spells and Ink against than the [b]Torn Bosses[/b]?

We'll be focusing (and talking) more on Bosses in the future - but [b]In The Edit[/b] brings some fresh polish to our grand foes! There are visual and audio feedback enhancements across the board, with some behavior and cooldown adjustments thrown in - all in service of boss fights that put your Scribe skills to the ultimate test ([i]while being clear, fair, balanced, and satisfying[/i]). 

[h1]The Polish of Pages - and All Other Things![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1855658b811bfe1fe9874ff28bedfaa6244b0bb1.jpg[/img]
[i]Details on details on details...[/i]

This interlude patch includes so much additional detail - Chapter endings, UI sound effects, fanfare, feedback, and so on! One of the most noticeable changes will be Pages of Power, now much more clearly identifiable in their grandeur!

Magical Pages will now be appropriately decorated as [b]Storied[/b], [b]Renowned[/b], [b]Epic[/b], [b]Legendary[/b], or [b]Unique [/b]([i]if you're lucky enough to read one[/i])!

If any details stand out as your favorite or you have feedback to share with us, please do! So much of this update was driven by feedback; it is truly helpful to us.

[h1]Epilogue - One Big Library[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/49f6ec2addd14be460062522516bce050963140e.jpg[/img]
[b]Interlude Patch: In The Edit[/b] also brings a handful of new Nook items - and introduces the community-requested ability to place items under tables (push in your chair, create your own dioramas, get creative)!

This update went through a fluid process with a lot of builds going on the testing branch. Hunting bugs, giving suggestions, breaking things in brand new ways - thank you everyone who tested[b] In The Edit[/b] ahead of time! 

As we look to the horizon, [i]Vellum's [/i]full launch is drawing closer - and you can [b]definitely [/b]expect it to be a rather large update! In preparation for 1.0, we'll be targeting smaller, Interlude Patch-sized updates (a truly hilarious thing to say in this particular blog post - yes) that will allow us to stay responsive to feedback, squeeze in some cool extra stuff, and keep focused on the next verse of this saga!

Thank you for playing Vellum - go read a book!

- [i]The Vellum Team [/i]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Feast
notes.notes:
Welcome, Scribes!

We've loved all the feedback and discussion after [b]Chapter VIII: Hard Cover[/b] and the addition of the [b]Teal[/b] Signature Ink! We continue to gather feedback and have been working on making improvements, with the next step being today's [b]Interlude Patch: Feast[/b]. 

On today's menu: some community requests in the form of [b]Page Omission[/b], dramatically improved enemy [b]Hit Reactions[/b], and major strides in [b]Game Performance[/b]! We've also continued to expand content to add variety to your adventures with new [b]Vignettes[/b] and [b]Player Pages[/b].

As always, you can check the in-game roadmap to see what's coming up. But for now, let's jump into the additions!

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d65ba51fbd40a91484a9aafb22345e52ee11b323.jpg[/img]
Like the Scribes and Torn - [b]Performance[/b] is an evolving battle. Little wins here and there get pushed back by crazier combos and new features. [b]Interlude Patch: Feast[/b] makes huge strides in winning back framerate with two major areas. 

The first is a new way of handling game actions (projectiles, explosions, arrow rains, etc.) by re-using old copies so we don't need to create or destroy effects each time they're used. This should give a sizable performance boost, [i]particularly[/i] later in Tomes within the Appendices when hundreds of effects are happening every second.

The second big improvement is in how we handle the Torn and their stats and behavior. With some aggressive data caching, multi-threaded logic, and more optimized code flow - we've seen [b]huge[/b] performance gains when there are many enemies on the battlefield.

While there is still plenty of room for improvement, these two major performance overhauls have increased performance in general combat by a [i]significant[/i] degree. And in late game runs, we've easily seen 100x improvements, going from 'seconds-per-frame' to 60fps in many cases! 

[h1]New Vignettes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/863bc3fb1d134391e5d2d94620b7327c9e4c879b.jpg[/img]
Deep within the Tomes, Scribes can find themselves in three new Vignettes! Scale the fungal depths of [b]Mycellum Quarry[/b], take in the view in [b]Overlook[/b], and dance with [b]Radiance[/b].

New Lore pages have appeared in the Vignettes of [b]Pride and Profit[/b], further detailing the paths of [b]Myriad[/b], [b]Verse[/b], and [b]Horizon[/b].

[h1]Hit Reactions[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2f008d7b5eca9e6bd197b5aa8fa59e7f6e966030.jpg[/img]
Another element of feedback we've seen echoed a number of times is wanting more feedback when you deal damage to the Torn.

This update adds two new interactions - [b]Damage Animations[/b] and [b]Hit Flash[/b]. Now, Torn will physically react to the damage they take, giving better feedback and making damage feel more impactful. Additionally, Torn you damage will flash the [b]color of your Signature Ink[/b], for some visible, thematic interaction.

If you find the Hit Flash distracting, you can disable it in the General Settings menu!

[h1]Pages of Power[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/06a4f33165d8edd7a0f065ff070edf13c07c6636.jpg[/img]
This update expands the Codex with over 20 new Pages of Power to help you push back the Torn! This time, we're focusing on build expansion and collaboration, with new interactions between your spells, as well as a bunch of new multiplayer [b]Ink Combinations[/b] (for example: your Orange Atlas might apply Blot if a Blue Scribe is standing nearby)!

[h1]Page Omission[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f4eea5a07fbffe3c68a10223f3a8200e5939c51d.jpg[/img]
Sometimes, you might pick up a page that doesn't quite cooperate with your build - now you can do something about it! By popular request, we've added the ability to [b]Remove Pages of Power[/b] you pick up during your run - just hold right click on the page in the Tab menu, and you can [b]Omit[/b] it from your book!

There might be a couple of odd interactions that need ironing out (omitting pages that give you stacking stats doesn't remove what you've already built up, etc.) - but we'll resolve them as we go, and we definitely think it's better to have the feature with a few quirks than not at all!

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]
[b]Interlude Patch: Feast[/b] also brings a smattering of bug fixes, adjustments, and some light tuning! We called this update 'Feast' for a few  reasons: to allude to the sheer [b]amount of stuff[/b], the Thanksgiving holiday, but more importantly - the [b]communal nature[/b] of this update!

In each post here, we make a point to write out how thankful we are for the enthusiasm and generosity of our players. Today's patch truly embodies the joy of our Early Access process; nearly every aspect of [b]Feast[/b] has been directly influenced by feedback and discussions in the community.

For those who celebrate it, have a superb Thanksgiving!
For everybody, thank you for making [i]Vellum[/i] better with us!
- [i]The Vellum Team[/i]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Initiative
notes.notes:
[i]Welcome to the table! Heroes, as evening approaches a new blog post appears... It says across the top:[/i]

"Happy Wednesday, Scribes! Vellum Early Access continues the adventure with Interlude Patch: Initiative!"

[i]It continues on, summarizing the game's patch today:[/i] [b]Clatter[/b] - a new generator spell, the [b]Torn Bestiary[/b], [b]Enhanced Healthbars[/b], and the start of [b]Improved Ascension[/b] mechanics. 

[i]With your passive perception score, you also notice the post eloquently reminds you that the Vellum Roadmap is available in game - always charting the development team's progress.[/i]

[i]What do you do next? [/i]

[h1]New Spell - Clatter[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/e907722b7da7723064f0ba95ad69f85b79625081.gif[/img]
[i]You want to battle? Great! [/i]

Roll to attack with [b]Clatter[/b]: a new generator spell that conjures a 20-sided die, then blasts it at your foes!

Clatter applies additional effects determined by the result of your conjured d20. These payloads vary from an explosive area burst generating extra mana at higher numbers to a gut-wrenching single point of damage when rolling a 1.

[i]If only there were Pages of Power to force the hand of fortune...[/i]

[h1]The Torn Codex[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/407d49a605f5ea8eeb5d0b5581a9ecf6c7dfd93e.jpg[/img]
[i]Ah - you'd like to research your adversaries? Good choice - they carry many secrets![/i]

The Codex has expanded again with lore and combat information about each of the Torn enemies you've encountered in your journey as a Scribe.

Whether you're waiting for your teammates to decide their loadouts or licking your wounds after a tragic defeat - there is always time to study your foes!

[h1]Enhanced Healthbar Information[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d921d5734d5abb0cfdb7c40f8bc01d70b7bfc538.jpg[/img]
[i]I understand - you'd like to learn in the heat of combat![/i]

With the new [b]Enhanced Healthbars[/b], you'll be able to track the important buffs and debuffs currently affecting the enemy Torn.

This includes specific statuses from your Signature Inks, like Blue's Blot and Pink's Outline.

[h1]Improving Ascension Mechanics[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f1e722394378018d31be00a77eaf4f1fec807f63.jpg[/img]
[i]As a more experienced adventurer, you'd like to reset and try a new path? Right this way...[/i]

We're iterating on the experience of an [b]Ascendant Scribe[/b]! There has been a helpful amount of feedback around the rewards and pacing goals of resetting progress and continuing the journey.

Now, after Ascending for the first time, Scribes will be reset to [b]Attunement 5[/b]. In addition, Ascendant Scribes - hungry for challenge or eager for faster leveling - will now be able to [b]accelerate[/b] their Attunement increases:

For every 5 Binding levels [b]above[/b] the target Goal, a successful run will [b]add +1 to your Attunement[/b] increase! 

We also know there is an appetite for more uses for Quillmarks and Gildings - we're on the case!

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]
[i]Heroes - time for a snack break![/i]

It has been an exciting and eventful stretch for us recently; we remain committed to finding new ways to creatively meet the challenges ahead - both expected and surprising!

Thank you for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm.

[i]Fun session, friends! Same time next week?[/i]

- [i]The Vellum Team [/i]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Preposition
notes.notes:
Happy Wednesday, Scribes! [i]Vellum[/i] Early Access blinks forward today with [b]Interlude Patch: Preposition[/b]!

Positions are key in the two new combat Arenas - and Scribes can now equip themselves with a potent teleport: [b]Foreshadow[/b]! New [b]Font Powers[/b] will now appear in Tomes and the game sees widespread performance improvements, bug-fixes, and some nice quality of life features!

As always, the [i]Vellum Roadmap[/i] tracks our journey across the Early Access process - check it out in-game to see what comes next!

[h1]New Arenas - A Destination Shredding![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/42017bd46397f00f98663f2a3f1f3d0f4ba8bdb9.jpg[/img]
Today brings two new combat Arenas! Push back the Torn on a tropical island inlet, complete with boardwalks and palm trees! 

Don't let your ink dry too fast in the second Arena - a mysterious ritual site deep in the desert... High ground, choke points, and a doorway fit for last stands and holdouts!

How shall the Scribes traverse such spaces?

[h1]New Spell - Foreshadow[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a8b6f39356b5a7569d882c4fe0cdcd39073112e7.gif[/img]

[b]Foreshadow[/b]. With two charges and unlimited range, this Spell lets bold Scribes warp themselves to face their targets head-on.

Be it aggressive gap-closing or panicked escapes - [b]Foreshadow[/b] opens the door for incredibly fast-paced bursts of action.

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/4c4ba3006786bb3e61c9648d16e04e8df40cbf40.jpg[/img]

There are a lot of ground effects in [i]Vellum[/i] at the same time (and sometimes the same space) - which makes today's performance improvements all the more impactful.

Projectors see a massive upgrade, affecting a large number of our area of effect spells and abilities. This should allow for smoother play under those high-load encounters - like when you've chosen [i]"Raving area size increased by 50%"[/i] and can't seem to kill off all those darn scorpions...

Status effects - another widespread pillar of the game - have also seen dramatic improvements. Vellum now handles big stack counts (like with Orange's Survey effect) much more efficiently!

[h1]Font Powers - Thank Our Lucky Stars[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2422bd8bb2caa31337d2cb0e3b1a5350fd6fba3c.jpg[/img]
We're adding some fresh new options to the general pool of [b]Font Powers[/b]! These powers come in all shapes and sizes - including new drops, some anti-Torn counterplay, a BELL?!, and more. 

With 16 new options in the pool, we're looking forward to hearing about your mid-run choices and discoveries!

[h1]Epilogue and Errata[/h1]
[b]Interlude Patch: Preposition [/b]comes fresh off the heels of a massive [b]Chapter VI[/b] update. We're continually energized to be reading and digesting your feedback -  from feelings on the Mana rework to questions on story elements, it is always an exciting and driving force for us to hear your experiences with [i]Vellum[/i].

We're also thrilled and intrigued when seeing new bug reports! The detail and back-and-forth is consistently helpful for us - and often sets up exciting puzzles for us to solve. Like Scribes, we get to explore the deep dark intricacies of the unknown and come out victorious!

Thank you for playing and helping to make the game better each step of the way!

- [i]The Vellum Team[/i]

[h1]Interlude Patch: Full House
[/h1]
Good day, Scribes! Welcome to our [i]ninth[/i] update, [b]Interlude Patch: Full House[/b] - introducing multiplayer [b]Quickmatch[/b], the burst-fire spell [b]Draw[/b], [b]Interface Pings[/b], and more! 

We've been openly talking about public games since the launch of [i]Vellum[/i] Early Access, often with the underlying goal of maintaining the best foundation for positive, shared experiences. This is a heavily-requested feature that opens some exciting new doors for Vellum.

Don't forget to keep an eye on the [i]Vellum Roadmap[/i] in-game to keep up with our progress (and catch a glimpse of what might lurk in the shadows ahead)! 

[h2]Quickmatch - A Legendary Study Group[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/b0e88c1df1f8034b15c9e14a70f2360732691ef5.png[/img]
Band together as a team of up to 4 Scribes to push back the Torn! New multiplayer options are available from the Main Menu.

[b]Quickmatch[/b] - Enter an open, Public Lobby in the Illuminated Library.
[b]Create Game[/b] - Choose to create a Public or Private Lobby (Private is open only to Friends/Invite/Room Code)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/484d362078fc16daa3a15f5c8be2cd190fb6d045.jpg[/img]
[b]Draw[/b] now has a seat at the Generator Spell table! Our new triple burst-fire spell deals a Hand of Cards (at high speeds) to cut your foes - however, casting too quickly in succession will widen the spread. 

How will you [i]deal[/i] with this new Generator? Let us know if it [i]suits[/i] you! Card pun!

[h2]Interface Pings and Communication Feed![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8884cdfad531ffdae3847f28669d0842f0ba7321.gif[/img]
[i]"Sharing the joys of discovery and the burden of challenge is core to the Vellum multiplayer experience."[/i]

We dropped this gem of a line in the previous Interlude Patch when introducing the new Ping Rework - with today's patch we get to push further toward that thesis with the new [b]Interface Ping[/b] system. 

In combination with a new [b]Communication Feed[/b], Interface Pings now allow Scribes to communicate where their focus is by pinging areas of the UI itself. Most items with a tooltip are able to be pinged, as well as buttons to move the game along:

[i]Fletch is ready to continue[/i]

[b]Interlude Patch: Full House[/b] doesn't have John Stamos, but it [i]does[/i] have the next best thing - [b]Improved Performance[/b]! In addition to dramatically improving Library rendering performance, we've introduced a new setting, [i]FSR Upscaling[/i], that will allow for improved performance elsewhere in addition to extra customization across the Quality/Performance spectrum. We're very interested in hearing how these settings impact your play experience - [i]please share your feedback with us[/i]!

On the gameplay side, we've added a few new [b]Pages of Power[/b] for the [b]Jot[/b] spell to start deepening its build potential. We've also squashed some Orange-related bugs, added some size safety mechanisms, and many other bits and bobs you can review in the patch notes below.

Our journey continues into the next big update - [b]Chapter V: The Hollows[/b]! Your feedback continues to aid our process, combat our writer's block, and provide unique perspectives. With Quickmatch arriving today, we're not only looking forward to hearing more from you - [b][i]we're honestly pumped to go play together[/i][/b]!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Live Update - 0.45.1 - (Difficulty Overhaul)
notes.notes:
Hello, Scribes!

We're releasing a patch today to adjust issues and address feedback relating to difficulty. There are also fixes and enhancements to the recent [b]Chapter III: Revelry & Respite[/b] update!

Overcoming satisfying hurdles is at the heart of [i]Vellum[/i]; Scribes direct the hunger of their foes, apply dangerous Bindings to Tomes, and venture into the depth of the Appendices - all in a quest to battle and defeat the Torn. 

[b]In service of challenge that is consistently satisfying, we're making significant adjustments to Vellum's difficulty.[/b]

Today's patch adjusts how [i]Vellum[/i] scales enemies across the board (Chapters, Bindings, Appendices). First off, we've fixed an important bug that had previously undercut the scaling factor of Bindings - so our intended difficulty curve had been 'leaking' a portion of its potency.

To combine with Bindings, we're substantially increasing the starting health values of Torn - with a small bump to their per-Chapter scaling. We're also adjusting the timing for Barrier regeneration for both Scribes and Torn to take slightly longer - giving more weight to Barrier-related powers and gameplay. We want a much more dangerous - but satisfying - iteration of the Torn:

[b]Our goal is for difficulty to be a better partner for player power - keeping focus on the best dynamic relationships of the game.[/b]

This is an impactful step toward balancing the game, but it [i]isn't the last step[/i]. We're eager to hear your feedback when playing with these changes and examining where [i]Vellum[/i]'s challenges find their brightest spots.

Thank you for playing!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Till Death
notes.notes:
[h1]Interlude Patch: Till Death[/h1]
Good day, Scribes - we hope you've been braving the seasons and studying up on your Inks since our last Chapter! We've heard a lot of excitement for Pink - thank you for your enthusiasm! Today, we're rolling out our newest [b]Interlude Patch: Till Death[/b]!

This patch addresses community feedback on death, danger, performance, Bonus Objectives, and balance! We also introduce a tiny new Boss we found. Let's take a look at the patch! [i](And, as always, you can check out the roadmap in-game to track our progress - and see what's next!)[/i]

[h2]Revisiting Danger and Death[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0e329f1014586d7ce5916242c7deee77283dca8d.png[/img]
We love high-stakes windows in games; skill, luck, instinct, preparation - you meet the challenge with everything you've got! Victory or defeat, you face your moment of truth head-on.

In [b]Till Death[/b], we're making targeted changes to improve these moments. Previously, these high-stakes windows came and went too quickly without us [i]knowing we were in them[/i]. That makes it hard for players to excel in the spotlight - to come out with a [i]clear and earned[/i] victory or [i]satisfying and fair[/i] defeat. The goal: [b]You must FEEL when the stakes are high and BELIEVE you can affect them.[/b]

Our major changes: [b]One-Shot Protection[/b], [b]Last Stand Removal[/b] (Solo), [b]Last Stand Rework[/b] (Multiplayer)

[b]One-Shot Protection[/b] - High danger hits are more likely to leave you at low health, allowing for players to react and take more dramatic advantage of moment-to-moment strategy and long-term build-making. This affects all Scribes (any levels, solo and multiplayer) and will not prevent death from intentional "Annihilation-level" events.

[b]Last Stand Removal[/b] (Solo) - We want the "fight for your life!" drama to happen in the naturally occurring dire moments carved out by One-Shot Protection and your defensives/builds. Ink Level revives still function and have new places in the Ink Level unlock order.

[b]Last Stand Rework[/b] (Multiplayer) - Reviving other players functions similarly to the current behavior. Downed Scribes may now choose to activate their Ink Level revives or keep fighting to fill up their revive bar. This bar is still capped and requires a teammate to stand nearby to finish the process. All downed Scribes now use a ranged Ink Torrent spell to damage foes from any range and stay engaged with the game around them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/54c7d3ebae6cd1edf9e1ad747122289f21139135.png[/img]

[h2]Splice Boss - "Big" Cap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3cabad2309d1e25f075fefa2022960666a543ae5.png[/img]
We've foraged for a new Boss to add to the Torn roster: [b]"Big" Cap[/b]! This fun little guy is just a cute and cuddly Splice Boss. 

[i]It's probably best to let him plant all the mushrooms he wants...[/i]

[h2]Pages of Power, Balance & Tuning, and Bonus Objectives[/h2]
We keep expanding the Codex! [b]Till Death[/b] (as always) brings new Pages of Power - including an avenue for some Generator-centric builds!

We've also spent some time tuning Blue, not only with some new pages and adjustments, but a buff to the Spread keyword! Blue's ability to tackle larger threats should be enhanced, while still keeping value on multi-dotting.

Bonus Objectives have all been tweaked! Based on some player feedback and a couple pieces of new tech, we've taken a light touch to nearly every Bonus Objective. Notably, we've also taken a performance pass to help clean up some wild and unwieldy combos (or strange occurrences with ally/foes tags getting confused). 

Thank you for playing [i]Vellum[/i] and sharing your thoughts with us!
- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Duels & Demise
notes.notes:
[h1]Duels & Demise Overview[/h1]
Today, we're releasing our first Interlude Patch: [b]Duels & Demise[/b]! Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/917950/announcements/detail/4196865993350963309]our Roadmap[/url] for more! 

We're fresh off launch and are continually surprised and energized by the feedback and reception of [i]Vellum[/i]. The palpable joy in the reviews, streams, comments, and more have been incredibly heartening.

Feedback continues to fuel our process - sharing details about how your experiences in the game met/didn't meet your expectations will always be useful to us. Thank you!

Duels & Demise includes three core items: [b]Foil, Death Recap, Pages & Balance[/b]

[h2]Foil: Mightier Than The Pen?[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0f99f24aa0857d1910d004edfc1e1fc8b977fc7b.gif[/img]
[b]Foil [/b]is a Generator Spell with up to three hits; summon an inky blade to slice twice, then lunge forward to damage many foes at once. Each swing restores some Barrier when hitting foes (but will not overflow).

[h2]Quality of Death Feature: Death Recap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a66bbecdf8e219cd6cb42916c1f2c3e0ae5f42a0.png[/img]
As the ever-evolving mission for more clarity and feedback in [i]Vellum [/i]continues - we landed on the [b]Death Recap[/b] as a useful addition.

You'll now be able to see the name, ability used, and damage dealt from the Torn who defeated you.

[h2]New Pages & Balance[/h2]
Overall, this Interlude Patch introduces [b]12 New Pages of Power[/b]: a selection of 5 Foil-specific and 7 Signature Ink-specific pages.

We won't spoil them here, but some of these new pages play into the balance changes we're making with this patch - specifically looking at defensive options and potency available for different Signature Inks. We're keeping an eye out for over-performers and adjusting/redistributing strength in specific areas.

We're still collecting data and feedback from the first few weeks of launch - so we're not making a [b]huge [/b]number of balance changes in this patch, but a more surgical selection. The introduction of Foil as a brand new combat area will surely add some new pressure and unlock new combinatoric strengths, so we'll be spending keen attention on balance and feedback.

[h2]Full Interlude Patch Notes: Duels & Demise[/h2]
[i]0.31.0[/i]
[h3]New Content & Balance[/h3]
- New Spell: [b]Foil[/b] - A melee Generator Spell, summoning a sword to deal a three-hit combo
- New Quality of Life Feature: [b]Death Recap[/b] - Will show the specific Torn who dealt a killing blow (along with ability and damage value)
- 5 New Pages of Power - Foil
- 7 New Pages of Power - 1+ per Signature Ink
- [b]Page of Power: Wards Wards Wards[/b] can now only activate once per ability, now generating 20 Barrier (was 30). ([i]Dev Note: We pulled power from this overperformer and have added another Page to the pool that still incentivizes Yellow's 'defense via offense' feel[/i])

- Signature Spells can no longer have cooldowns reduced lower than 4s
- [b]Binding: Toxic[/b] now reduces Torn damage by 75% (was 90%). ([i]Dev Note: Toxic should be an intriguing trade off of danger profiles, but shouldn't be as strong a boon as it is currently[/i])

notes.title: Live Update - 0.30.3
notes.notes:
Happy Wednesday, Scribes!

We've got another delivery of fixes and adjustments headed your way! This patch also includes some light balance changes and tuning. Let us know how impactful these changes feel as you go about mending the Tomes!

We're continuing our quests for improved performance, bugfixing, and controller tweaks. Please keep the reports coming our way - the clips, screenshots, and in-depth descriptions from the community have been a huge help in slaying these bugs.

What a wonderful launch week - thank you all for playing! This week, look for a blog post from us with details on [i]the next chapters of Vellum[/i]. See you in the Library!

[h3]Balance & Tuning[/h3]
- Scribe Barriers now recharge 33% of their full value per second, up from 15%. ([i]Dev Note: This should help with getting back into the fray after being on the back foot, as well as increase overall survivability[/i])
- Barrier regeneration is no longer delayed by damage that is fully absorbed/reduced
- Binding Levels above 46 should now scale damage and health properly. ([i]Dev Note: This will increase difficulty, while aiming to keep high Binding Levels meaningful.[/i])
- [i]Font Power: Ballista[/i] now fires one large, piercing bolt instead of a burst of arrows
- [i]Font Power: Chrome[/i], Sweet Chrome now applies on tick, rather than needing to re-enter
- Boss Fights: adds spawn slower in co-op games, slightly reduced number of adds. This should result in more face time with just the Boss
- [i]Torn Page: Morale Boost[/i] will no longer heal other Elites or Bosses. Phew.
- Binding Attunement Levels should now properly reach the Maximum Attunement Level (20). This caps the Quillmark bonus, but doesn't prevent playing at higher Bindings.  ([i]Dev Note: Binding Attunement 20 as a maximum is our goal area for balancing difficulty and rewards - we want to make sure the appeal of Binding Levels above 20 is about the challenge, not necessarily optimal rewards[/i])

[h3]Gameplay Fixes[/h3]
- [i]Bonus Objective: Collect[/i] is improved and should be less likely to spawn in impossible areas (please let us know if you find any more areas)
- [i]Bonus Objective: Header[/i] is now more ball-like and has an indicator for the Font ([i]Gooooooooooal![/i])
